messages:
siddharth: Hey team, opened PR 8235 — microbatch scheduler change. It's a small refactor that should increase throughput for large batches, but my perf run shows a regression on small-batch p95. Need 2 approvals to merge this week so we can include it in the next canary. https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/8235 :eyes:

kyle: linking the PR now. can you paste the benchmark snippet? is this on the same infra as our canary?

siddharth: yep ran on canary-a100-8x, same container image. short bench below (runs are 5k small-batch queries / 10k large). results:
```
small-batch (batch_size <=4): p50 12ms -> 13ms (+8%), p95 32ms -> 36ms (+12%)
large-batch (batch_size >=32): throughput +6%, latency p95 unchanged
```
CI perf check flagged the small-batch p95 bump.

ci-bot: perf-check: PR 8235 — small-batch p95 +12% (threshold 10%). unit tests: pass. e2e: pass. see artifacts: https://ci.redwood/8235/artifacts

jenna: thanks. can you paste the exact diff that touches the scheduling logic? curious if it's an allocation timing or kv-cache interaction.

siddharth: short diff: moved early flush from end-of-step to start-of-step to reduce idle for long seqs. suspect it increases scheduling jitter for tiny requests.

paul: if that's the case we could guard the early-flush behind a batch-size threshold (skip for batch <=8). simple and low-risk.

kyle: agree with paul. also, can we add a quick microbench in CI that runs the small-batch profile so future PRs catch this?

siddharth: happy to add the guard + microbench. question for reviewers: is this urgent to block the canary? i can push a follow-up today.

eva: i'd prefer we hold the merge until the guard is in. small-batch p95 is user-facing for chat flows. if siddharth can land both in a single PR or back-to-back, i'll +1 after the guard.

kyle: i'll review once you push the guard. if CI microbench added, tag me and i'll run local loop.

jenna: +1 to adding the threshold. small change, easy rollback if anything else pops up.

siddharth: thanks — I'll open a small patch (8236) to gate early-flush for batch_size > 8 and add a short microbench job. pinging for reviews: @eva @kyle please when you have a moment. :pray:

ci-bot: note: test-run 8235.2 queued for microbench (small-batch). artifact link: https://ci.redwood/8236/microbench

paul: sounds good. for rollout plan — once guard lands we can canary to 5% traffic and monitor p95. if stable after 24h, ramp.

eva: sounds like a plan. thanks for the quick follow-up.

siddharth: will do, thanks all.
